name: Figma-To-Code
description: Convert Figma designs to code using AI - No setup required for users!

scripts.dev: npm run build && echo '🚀 Plugin built! Install in Figma Development mode.'
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const content = fs.readFileSync('ui.html', 'utf8').replace(/const GEMINI_API_KEY = '[^']*';/, \"const GEMINI_API_KEY = 'PLACEHOLDER_API_KEY_TO_BE_REPLACED';\"); fs.writeFileSync('ui.html', content); console.log('🧹 API key placeholder restored');"
scripts.setup: echo '📋 Setting up API key...' && cp env.example .env && echo '✅ Created .env file. Please edit it with your API key and run npm run build'
